claim_coverage.evidence: Source PDF p.34 equations A.1-A.3 and lemma/proof match the target; forward label reversal fails to reverse site arguments.
DUD=L, rank-2 precursors, both normalizations, and unital persistence give (3,2) versus (2,3) for all lengths.
Exact cumulative block maps and depolarizer persistence give (4,3,2) versus (2,2,2), with CDFs 1/3 versus 1 at length 2.
Direct word expansion on T^-1 with local shift T^-1 gives W_hat_n(omega)=W_n(T^-n omega)* and fixed-block laws.
F>0 and G>0 give full left/right multiplication spans; persistence holds in both directions on a common invariant full-measure set; fixed-block CDFs imply onset laws including infinity.
Onsets (4,2,3), law equal to (4,3,2), pointwise distinct at phases 1 and 2.
Exact subspace recurrences yield original (2,3) first onsets and infinite eventual onsets; reversed first/eventual (2,infinity); fixed-block probability 1/2 for every n>=2.
No counterexample to source Theorem 4.2, Theorem 5.5, Corollary 5.9 or Proposition A.9 is established; no full validation of those theorems was performed.
Limited primary-source search only; no systematic priority search.

additional_source_concerns.finding: The local implication from a proper Kraus-word span to a nonzero common-kernel projection is invalid in general. Dephasing has a proper span but zero common kernel; a trace-preserving block cannot have a nonzero common-kernel projection.
additional_source_concerns.scope_limit: Separate source-proof concern, not a defect in this manuscript or a proof that Proposition A.9 is false; no full repair or full source certification undertaken.
